links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT-5 antibiotic prophylaxis answers with AHA/AAE/ADA guidelines, rated by one endodontist
links.effect: Full agreement in 10/17 (58.8%), partial in 4 (23.5%) due to unnecessary expansion of indications, disagreement in 3 (17.6%), mainly immunocompromised cases; no response deemed clinically unsafe.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated full agreement with expert, guideline-based recommendations in 10 of 17 scenarios (58.8%), particularly in classical teaching domains such as infective endocarditis prophylaxis, antibiotic selection, dosage, and timing.

screen.reason: Evaluated ChatGPT responses to 17 predefined clinical endodontic scenarios against clinical guidelines without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
